sentences.en: I didn't quite catch the name of that designer.
sentences.zh: 我没太听清楚那个设计师的名字。

sentences.en: He wants to be a Lego model designer when he grows up.
sentences.zh: 他长大后想成为一名乐高模型设计师。

sentences.en: I used to want to be a hairdresser, or a fashion designer.
sentences.zh: 我过去想过要做一名发型师或者时装设计师。

senses.zh: 由设计师专门设计的；享有盛名的；赶时髦的
